method: Closed original file reconciliation, native stdlib and pure schema/lexical/PII definitions; no WSL/process/network/model/database execution.
offload_evidence_limit: Full layer count is not inferred from -ngl99. GPU participation uses pinned model/server, actual props and the exact owned GPU-compute PID.
scope_limits: No independent live request, Git operation or graph rerun performed.
Original Go ledger is asserted by state-check source and successful command receipt; snapshots omit ledger.
Original DB after-full and before-stop equality is enforced by frozen isolation code and successful actual phase receipts; no independent post-query or full after-phase snapshot is claimed.
Successful exact replay is evidenced by frozen replay code plus attributed zero-exit result, not per-case consumption receipts.
